Do not change the signatures.
original_test_src:
import pytest
from paging import page_count, page_items

def test_page_count():
    assert page_count(10, 3) == 4
    assert page_count(9, 3) == 3
    assert page_count(1, 3) == 1
    assert page_count(0, 3) == 0
    assert page_count(7, 1) == 7
def test_page_count_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        page_count(5, 0)
def test_page_items():
    items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert page_items(items, 1, 2) == [1, 2]
    assert page_items(items, 2, 2) == [3, 4]
    assert page_items(items, 3, 2) == [5]
def test_page_items_out_of_range():
    items = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert page_items(items, 4, 2) == []
    assert page_items(items, 0, 2) == []
    assert page_items(items, -1, 2) == []
    assert page_items([], 1, 2) == []
